summary: Global-E Online Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of Passport Global Inc., a US-based e-commerce logistics company. The deal, initially announced May 26, 2026, is valued at $350 million, funded by approximately equal portions of cash and Global-E ordinary shares, with up to $75 million in additional contingent consideration based on performance targets. The acquisition adds standard shipping, multi-carrier network, and non-MoR capabilities. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Watch for integration execution and contingent earn-out milestones.
